issues: Search-hit total is inconsistent: the listed search rows sum to 94, but the text reports 83 hits.
Contradiction on the low-uACR slope effect: point estimate is given as 76% (95% CI 32–120), yet the text twice says the point estimate exceeds 100%.
The specified KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline was not used; a substitute BMJ guideline is used for practice context, though this is disclosed.
judge.rationale: The delivery answers the brief in depth, correctly separates randomized trial evidence from post-trial observational follow-up, and counts 3 reports as 1 primary study. Derived estimates are named and sourced. Minor arithmetic/description errors and the guideline substitution reduce correctness and evidence handling; safety framing appropriately preserves evidence levels and avoids action on derived estimates.
